question: Pointing to a photograph, a woman said to a man, "She is the only child of the sister of the only son of your paternal grandfather". How is the man related to the person in the picture?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Given: Pointing to a photograph, a woman said to a man, "She is the only child of the sister of the only son of your paternal grandfather". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042e413310bc3c9d83e85664c4096fdbd95ce2965ae77c44aef007e06bc65a8.png] 

So, the man is "**Mother's Brother's Son**" of the person in the picture.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Mother's Brother's Son".**
